TARGETLINE.title: Target Line
TARGETLINE.setting.lineColor.name: Line Color
TARGETLINE.setting.lineColor.hint: Color of the thin core line (hex, e.g. #00aaff).
TARGETLINE.setting.lineAlpha.name: Line Opacity
TARGETLINE.setting.lineWidth.name: Line Width
TARGETLINE.setting.lineWidth.hint: Width of the core line in pixels.
TARGETLINE.setting.glowColor.name: Glow Color
TARGETLINE.setting.glowColor.hint: Color of the glowing halo effect (hex).
TARGETLINE.setting.glowAlpha.name: Glow Opacity
TARGETLINE.setting.glowWidth.name: Glow Width
TARGETLINE.setting.glowWidth.hint: Width of the glow effect in pixels.
TARGETLINE.setting.dashLength.name: Dash Length
TARGETLINE.setting.dashLength.hint: Length of each dash segment in pixels.
TARGETLINE.setting.gapLength.name: Gap Length
TARGETLINE.setting.gapLength.hint: Space between dashes in pixels. 0 = solid line.
TARGETLINE.setting.animateOffset.name: Marching Ants Animation
TARGETLINE.setting.animateOffset.hint: Animates the dashes moving along the line.
TARGETLINE.setting.offsetSpeed.name: Animation Speed
TARGETLINE.setting.offsetSpeed.hint: How fast the dashes move (pixels per frame).
TARGETLINE.setting.pulseSpeed.name: Pulse Speed
TARGETLINE.setting.pulseSpeed.hint: Pulsing speed of the endpoint circles. 0 = no pulse.
TARGETLINE.setting.animationDirection.hi: The direction the dashes travel along the line.
